thread:
ana: Thanks for the all-hands. Opening a follow-up thread specifically for the customer wins/losses section. Drop clarifying questions, asks for leadership, or quick notes here and Ill triage.

matt: Quick Q: multiple customers asking for per-route cost breakdown in the console. Is that on the roadmap?

ana: Good callout. Product is tracking per-route billing export + API endpoint. Targeting a Q2 beta, not committed yet.

leah: Sales said we closed a deal because of our fallback-routing demo. Can we make a short playbook "Enable fallback for mission-critical apps" with YAML examples? That would help AE decks.

sam: +1 on playbook. Also loss signal: a customer hit model regression after applying a quantized variant. We need clear guidance on which models to pin and a pre-flight smoke test.

priya: I can draft a release eval checklist: golden prompts, perf smoke, token-level regression checks, embedding drift tests. Volunteer to own first pass.

derek: Partner request: per-tenant KV cache controls and eviction hooks. This is blocking a POC. How should we prioritize?

jordan: For cost transparency work, infra needs anonymized billing event samples. @matt can you drop an example CSV to the shared drive?

matt: Will upload a sanitized sample CSV by EOD.

ana: Leadership clarifying handoff thresholds: interim rule  Solutions Engineering handles infra/config-heavy POCs; Sales Eng handles feature/requirements POCs until perf/security checklist passes; then transfer to Customer Success. I'll formalize and share a short doc.

leah: Proposed top-5 playbooks to capture: 1) Fallback routing playbook, 2) Quantization & eval checklist, 3) Cost transparency how-to, 4) Per-tenant cache controls, 5) SLA & enterprise onboarding checklist.

sam: Playbooks should include an escalation template for field teams (impact, replication steps, suggested mitigations).

ana: Action items Ill own: compile top-5 and run triage with eng/product this week; leah+sam draft fallback playbook; priya draft eval checklist; matt upload billing sample; derek create ticket for partner KV needs.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-1927 "Customer signals: wins & losses playbooks" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-1927 :spiral_calendar:

ana: Closing thread in 48h unless more comments. Thanks all. :handshake:
